headline: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin Carted Off With Knee Injury
summary: OCTOBER 20: McLaurin is set to undergo an MRI today, but Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports the Commanders fear a season-ending injury occurred in this case. headline: Giants releasing RB Najee Harris, source says
summary: The Giants are releasing running back Najee Harris, a source told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport. Harris started Sunday's loss against the Saints but had just two yards on four carries.

headline: Titans abruptly release DT Jordan Elliott for undisclosed reasons
summary: The Titans abruptly released defensive tackle Jordan Elliott on Tuesday, citing an undisclosed "incident" from Thursday at the team's facility.
